Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Conjures a barrage of meteors. Celestial projectiles rain down, inflicting area-of-effect damage to adversaries within range.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Conjures a barrage of meteors. Celestial projectiles rain down, inflicting area-of-effect damage to adversaries within range.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Generates volatile lava droplets. Molten projectiles detonate on impact, dealing area-of-effect damage to enemies within the blast radius.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Generates volatile lava droplets. Molten projectiles detonate on impact, dealing area-of-effect damage to enemies within the blast radius.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Channels the combined energies of two Zelkorian spellcasters. Unleashes a potent area-of-effect explosion, engulfing the targeted zone in magical devastation.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Channels the combined energies of two Zelkorian spellcasters. Unleashes a potent area-of-effect explosion, engulfing the targeted zone in magical devastation.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Conjures a blazing barrier that protects the caster and damages nearby foes. Creates a hazardous zone, deterring close-quarters engagement.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Conjures a blazing barrier that protects the caster and damages nearby foes. Creates a hazardous zone, deterring close-quarters engagement.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Projects an intense beam of concentrated fire forward. Inflicts damage to enemies in its path, creating a linear zone of destruction.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Projects an intense beam of concentrated fire forward. Inflicts damage to enemies in its path, creating a linear zone of destruction.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Manifests a colossal fire dragon on the battlefield. Unleashes devastating waves of fire, incinerating foes within its vicinity.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Manifests a colossal fire dragon on the battlefield. Unleashes devastating waves of fire, incinerating foes within its vicinity.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Unleashes electrical energy that arcs between targets. Creates a chain reaction of lightning, damaging multiple enemies in rapid succession.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Unleashes electrical energy that arcs between targets. Creates a chain reaction of lightning, damaging multiple enemies in rapid succession.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Generates electric sparks. Sparks leap between nearby adversaries, creating unpredictable patterns of electrical damage.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Generates electric sparks. Sparks leap between nearby adversaries, creating unpredictable patterns of electrical damage.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Conjures a powerful wind vortex at the target location. Lifts and suspends enemies, dealing continuous damage from intense pressure and turbulent forces.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Conjures a powerful wind vortex at the target location. Lifts and suspends enemies, dealing continuous damage from intense pressure and turbulent forces.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Summons a localized maelstrom around the caster. Unleashes destructive forces on nearby enemies, combining violent winds and lightning.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Summons a localized maelstrom around the caster. Unleashes destructive forces on nearby enemies, combining violent winds and lightning.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Manifests spectral wolves charged with electrical energy. Unleashes ethereal canines that materialize near the caster. Wolves lunge at nearby foes, delivering shocking assaults.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Manifests spectral wolves charged with electrical energy. Unleashes ethereal canines that materialize near the caster. Wolves lunge at nearby foes, delivering shocking assaults.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Transfers static charge to the ground. Creates an electrified field in the targeted area. Damages enemies who traverse the charged terrain.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Transfers static charge to the ground. Creates an electrified field in the targeted area. Damages enemies who traverse the charged terrain.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Invokes cosmic forces to manifest razor-sharp blades from the sky. Blades rain down and embed in the ground in a radial pattern, damaging nearby adversaries.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Invokes cosmic forces to manifest razor-sharp blades from the sky. Blades rain down and embed in the ground in a radial pattern, damaging nearby adversaries.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Manifests a ring of electric dragons around the caster. Dragons orbit the user, crackling with intense electrical energy. Inflicts damage to foes who come into contact with the ethereal serpents.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Manifests a ring of electric dragons around the caster. Dragons orbit the user, crackling with intense electrical energy. Inflicts damage to foes who come into contact with the ethereal serpents.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Conjures a rotating array of razor-sharp blades around the caster. Creates a mobile zone of cutting force, damaging enemies who venture too close.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Conjures a rotating array of razor-sharp blades around the caster. Creates a mobile zone of cutting force, damaging enemies who venture too close.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Generates pools of poison around the caster. Creates hazardous zones on the ground that persist briefly. Damages enemies who come into contact with or traverse the toxic areas.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Generates pools of poison around the caster. Creates hazardous zones on the ground that persist briefly. Damages enemies who come into contact with or traverse the toxic areas.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Manifests an ethereal blade imbued with arcane energy. Blade rotates, emitting waves of force that damage nearby foes.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Manifests an ethereal blade imbued with arcane energy. Blade rotates, emitting waves of force that damage nearby foes.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Unleashes a homing orb of arcane energy. Orb phase-shifts through enemies, damaging them as it travels outward. On its return path, it continues to damage foes in its way back to the caster.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Unleashes a homing orb of arcane energy. Orb phase-shifts through enemies, damaging them as it travels outward. On its return path, it continues to damage foes in its way back to the caster.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Summons ethereal blood dragons from thin air. Dragons surge towards foes, leaving trails of caustic mist that damage enemies.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Summons ethereal blood dragons from thin air. Dragons surge towards foes, leaving trails of caustic mist that damage enemies.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Unleashes chaotic bursts of reality-warping arcane energy. Creates multiple explosions, forming a sphere of otherworldly devastation around the battlefield.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Unleashes chaotic bursts of reality-warping arcane energy. Creates multiple explosions, forming a sphere of otherworldly devastation around the battlefield.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Conjures a pulsating orb on the ground. Orb accumulates charge over time, periodically releasing damaging waves of increasing intensity.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Conjures a pulsating orb on the ground. Orb accumulates charge over time, periodically releasing damaging waves of increasing intensity.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Manifests incendiary totems around the caster. Totems explode on contact, creating a tactical minefield of fiery eruptions.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Manifests incendiary totems around the caster. Totems explode on contact, creating a tactical minefield of fiery eruptions.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Erects a mystical totem infused with arcane and primordial fire. Totem radiates waves of eldritch flame, searing nearby foes.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Erects a mystical totem infused with arcane and primordial fire. Totem radiates waves of eldritch flame, searing nearby foes.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Erects an electrified totem channeling celestial lightning. Obelisk draws down lightning bolts, creating a field of electrical havoc around it.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Erects an electrified totem channeling celestial lightning. Obelisk draws down lightning bolts, creating a field of electrical havoc around it.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Spawns a Kraken Seed near the target. Seeds appear in random locations around struck enemies, ready to unleash aquatic fury.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Spawns a Kraken Seed near the target. Seeds appear in random locations around struck enemies, ready to unleash aquatic fury.

Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.SourceString: Channels crackling lightning force through both arms. Emits damaging electrical energy to enemies on either side of the caster.
Description_12_69733E474E7851A5EF4441AEF.LocalizedString: Channels crackling lightning force through both arms. Emits damaging electrical energy to enemies on either side of the caster.
